_about: Limits, budgets, thresholds and ethics switches of the batch runner (JP, 2026-11-25). The values were set by JP; change them here with a note in LOG.md. Run scripts/selftest.py after an edit. Cap raised from 5.55 to 8.00 per batch on 2026-11-25 for the four-paper pilot (JP), batch mode only; the pilot runs in two batches (extraction and checks, then drafting and ratings) with a fresh cap each. Revert to 5.55 after the pilot unless JP says otherwise. Recheck and adjudicate budgets raised on 2026-11-25 after pilot run 1: Sol hit max_output_tokens on 3 of 4 papers (its reasoning counts against the budget). Picost budget raised to 40,000 + 1,000 per page after Woelfle (11 pages) ran out at 35,000 in pilot run 1. 2026-11-25 (JP): small check stages run in standard mode; a request or batch still out 5 minutes after all but about 10% finished is cancelled and marked for human review; at most 3 questions per paper, taken from the Abstract and Introduction; target of 30 minutes of work for four papers. project_question (JP, 2026-11-25): the overarching Elicit question; every question extracted from any PDF is taken to fit under it. 2026-11-25 (JP, later): no caps on questions, findings, EVDs, CLMs or CVTs; worst_case_findings_per_paper is only a planning number for output budgets. 2026-11-25: picost output budget raised (base 56000, max 80000) after Woelfle hit MAX_TOKENS twice with no cap on findings. Gemini batch refuses more than 65536 output tokens, so picost max is 65000 (larger papers need standard mode). picost max 120000 for standard mode; Gemini batch requests are clamped to 65000 in llm_batch. 2026-11-26 (JP): pilot cap is $6 per batch (new goal; was $8). Standard mode is fine for piloting, and JP is asked standard or batch every time papers are given. 2026-11-26 (JP): EVDs with a decision-model score below 0.60 are checked and rewritten by a separate frontier model (evd_rework role, Opus 5.5; stage draft_rework, always standard mode). 2026-11-26 (JP): batches of at most 3 papers with strong human review; a new batch is refused until JP has marked the earlier ones reviewed (lives_run.py --mark-reviewed). 2026-11-26 (JP): the 3-papers-per-batch rule is ignored for today (max_papers 4, review gate waived on the command line); set max_papers back to 3 afterwards. picost base 80000: Woelfle's picost-v7 extraction ended with finishReason CONTINUATION at 67000. 2026-11-26 (JP): quote_check stage (Sonnet 5.5 reads a screenshot of each extracted quote; cents per paper, always standard mode).

never_commit: private extractions of copyrighted text beyond short verbatim spans
ethics.downloads_need_listing: report every downloaded supplement (file, source URL, size) and never bypass a paywall or login

project_question: In benchmarking experiments, how accurately, quickly, and cost-effectively can Large Language Models (LLMs), Pretrained Language Models (PLMs), other NLP models, fine-tuned systems, and AI agents evaluate scholarly abstracts, preprints, and full research reports (including journal articles, conference proceedings, scholarly coursework, research proposals and ethics-review materials), across broad tasks such as peer review and narrower tasks such as error and limitation detection, critical appraisal, risk-of-bias assessment, reporting-guideline compliance, claim checking, novelty assessment, replicability prediction, ethics and style compliance, protocol and registration concordance, plagiarism and duplicate-publication detection, and distinguishing human-written from AI-generated scholarly writing? Evidence: empirical comparisons of AI judgments against human experts or another reference standard with quantitative results, plus time and cost where reported.

writing._about: EVD writing-rules check (JP, 2026-11-26): all-caps words of four or more letters are flagged unless listed here (names of tools, models and metrics).
